description: A black hard case sits open on the table with two small white round items inside, and a gray rectangular item and a small rubber duck are on the tabletop in front of it. The right hand reaches to the duck, lifts it, and places the duck into the open case, then the right hand moves to the lid and swings it downward while the left hand comes in to steady the case, making the case a two-hand object as it closes.
